title: Staging Activation Recovery trusted-ingress provisioning, durable replay, and shared environment convergence

phases.objective: Preserve the governed Staging Activation Recovery trusted-ingress path while introducing one shared Staging/Production environment-convergence engine that classifies repairable release drift, builds an immutable profile-bound reconciliation plan, stops at an explicit approval checkpoint, and emits only a governed handoff without performing provider, database, Production, or secret mutation.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Docker Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The governed exact-main Worker deployment owns an independent Ed25519 Recovery ingress private key, publishes only the matching public origin-trust artifact after exact-SHA Worker readback, One-Click hydrates only non-secret exact trust into ignored local Staging configuration, the origin atomically consumes Recovery JTIs from persistent app storage, and /admin/recovery/staging/* can reach the bounded Recovery surface without connector.mad4b.com or Production authority. Certification may still report blocked until genuine signed readiness evidence exists.
steps: Bind smart convergence to an exact current origin/main commit and a passed Staging schema/governance preflight.
Build the Staging Activation Worker with an independent Ed25519 Recovery ingress signing keypair separate from the policy-attestation key.

Place the ingress private JWK and key ID only in the ephemeral Wrangler secrets file; emit a public-only origin-trust artifact with exact source SHA, Worker source-set digest, policy hash, issuer, audience and key ID.
Deploy through the existing governed Staging Worker workflow and publish the origin-trust artifact only after public exact-SHA health readback succeeds.
Download that exact workflow-run artifact locally and hydrate only the public trust fields into ignored .env.staging.
Decode the single-line escaped public PEM at the origin trust boundary and verify issuer, audience, host, exact deployment SHA, request bindings and key ID.
Use the deployment-owned absolute /app/data/recovery-ingress path for atomic single-filesystem replay claims only in local Windows/Docker Staging when no higher authority injected a replay store.
Run the Staging One-Click core once more after convergence so the app restarts with the exact trusted-ingress configuration.
assertions: connector.mad4b.com is not a route, fallback, authority source or provisioning dependency for Staging Activation Recovery.
The Worker Recovery private key never appears in origin-trust.json, .env.staging, workflow summaries or repository evidence.
The public origin-trust artifact is uploaded only after successful Worker deployment and exact-SHA public health readback.
Local Recovery replay claims use the canonical durable replay-store contract and atomic exclusive filesystem claims; missing or invalid replay authority still fails closed.
Green /health alone does not suppress Recovery trust convergence; gateway_recovery_trusted_ingress is a typed recoverable Staging-only reason.

No Production deployment, Production mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, Hostinger mutation, database mutation, migration apply, ruleset mutation or synthetic live certification is authorized by this feature.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The same engine selects the Staging or Production profile, classifies Activation Gateway release drift, creates a deterministic immutable plan bound to repository/source branch/commit and policy identity, stops at approval_required without mutation, and after a matching approval returns only a handoff_ready state for the governed apply capability; provider execution remains outside this engine.
steps: Load and validate mad4b.environment-convergence-registry.v1 and require both environments to share environment_convergence.v1.
Bind the requested environment to its exact source branch, runtime adapter, Activation Gateway policy key, policy path, public host and governed authority metadata.
Classify gateway_exact_commit, gateway policy hash/key/staleness failures as repairable convergence drift while keeping unreachable or profile-mismatched dependencies blocked.
Build a canonical plan containing the exact release identity, environment profile binding, classified drift, bounded reconciliation-pass limit and governed plan/apply capability names.
Hash the canonical plan as plan_sha256 and expose it as an immutable plan identity.
Without approval, stop at approval_checkpoint with status=approval_required and perform no apply action.
Accept an approval only when environment, release commit and plan_sha256 exactly match the current plan; otherwise remain approval_required.

With a matching approval, return status=handoff_ready and next_stage=apply while emitting only the governed capability handoff; do not invoke Cloudflare, GitHub workflow dispatch, Hostinger, SQL, migration, database or Production mutation.
Keep certification as the final judge after a later governed apply path and never infer certification success from planning or approval.
assertions: Staging and Production use one engine and one environment_convergence.v1 state machine; environment differences are data profiles and authority bindings only.
The Staging profile binds main/local_windows_docker/activation_gateway_staging/activation-dev.mad4b.com and the Production profile binds Production/hostinger/activation_gateway/activation.mad4b.com.
Every repairable plan is bound to an exact repository, profile source branch, 40-character commit SHA, policy identity and maximum reconciliation-pass limit.
The same inputs produce the same plan_sha256 and the returned plan is immutable.
No approval means approval_required; an incorrect approval never advances to apply.
A matching approval advances only to handoff_ready and does not execute the apply capability.
The shared engine performs zero provider, database, migration, Production, ruleset, workflow-dispatch or secret mutation.
Top-level AutoPilot orchestrators remain free of provider credentials, direct Cloudflare API calls, wrangler deploy and gh workflow run implementation.

phases.objective: Production provider execution remains outside this feature; the shared engine may classify and plan with the Production profile but cannot deploy or mutate Production.
blockers: Production apply requires its separate governed release, C5 authority, approval, execution and certification lifecycle.
This feature grants no Production database, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare DNS, deployment or Recovery execution authority.
